title: Instagram Head Adam Mosseri Expects AI Negativity to Grow
excerpt: Instagram head Adam Mosseri believes negative public sentiment toward artificial intelligence is likely to increase.
body_html:
Instagram head Adam Mosseri stated in a recent interview that public negativity surrounding artificial intelligence is likely to increase. Speaking on the Colin and Samir podcast, Mosseri addressed recent backlash against AI, including instances of college students booing technology chief executives at graduation ceremonies.

Mosseri noted that widespread dislike for artificial intelligence extends well beyond young people and creative professionals, indicating that skepticism toward the technology is broad.
